data: You let out a charming cry, dealing emotional damage to any creature in range that can hear you. This move automatically hits for {dice} {type} damage unless a creature is in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig, Bounce, etc.
Instead of automatically hitting, targets make a CHA save against your MOVE DC. On failure, they take full damage and have disadvantage on their next attack. On success, they take half damage.
Works great if the user goes first this turn.
4 Appeal points if used first this turn, 2 Appeal points if not used first this turn.
